subject: BSF-Derived Chitosan Partnership Inquiry — Insectta
body:
Hello Insectta Team,

We are reaching out from MRA (Bangladesh) regarding your work in BSF-derived chitosan and insect biotech.

We are exploring strategic sourcing and partnership opportunities for high-purity BSF chitosan. Could you please share:
  1. Product specifications & purity grades
  2. MOQ and pricing tiers
  3. Certifications (ISO, GMP, etc.)

Looking forward to a productive conversation.

Warm regards,
MRA Outreach Team
Dhaka, Bangladesh
